# House of Happiness — Boutique Aparthotel, Khlong San, Bangkok

> Independent 15-unit serviced-apartment hotel on the Thonburi side of the Chao Phraya River in Khlong San, Bangkok, Thailand. Rated 8.8/10 from 770+ verified guest reviews on Booking.com. Guests can book directly with the owners by LINE, WhatsApp or email and pay at the hotel.

## Key facts
- Address: 558/1 Tha Din Daeng 16, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand (GPS 13.734137, 100.505014)
- Rooms: Standard (one double bed, sleeps 2) · Studio (two single beds, sleeps 2) · Deluxe (extra-large room with double bed and sofa corner, sleeps 2, max 3). Rates are quoted on request via LINE / WhatsApp / email and are not published on this site.
- Policies: minimum stay 2 nights · check-in 14:00–22:00 · check-out 12:00 · no deposit · pay at the hotel (cash, Thai bank transfer, PromptPay) — no online payment required
- Every unit: private city-view balcony, air conditioning, refrigerator, TV, free Wi-Fi, free bottled water; coin laundry on site; no restaurant, no parking
- Nearby: Sampeng Market ~900 m, Chao Phraya Sky Park ~1.3 km, Wat Pho ~1.8 km, Chinatown (Yaowarat) ~2 km, ICONSIAM ~5 min by car, BTS Gold Line Khlong San station
